name: Sound Control
subtitle: Headphone remote for iOS
description: Unofficial remote for headphones that expose the link2 accessory protocol (tested with the WF-1000XM5): noise cancelling, Ambient level, equalizer presets with a draggable curve and Clear Bass, battery levels, multipoint source switching, a live audio waveform and Siri Shortcuts. Not affiliated with any headphone manufacturer.
